Description: Turn an Umbraco site into an installable, offline-capable app, and see who installed it from the backoffice you are already signed into. Free and self-hosted: the install data lands in your own database and never leaves your server, so there is no third-party dashboard to log into and no processor to declare.

AuthorDetails.Name: BaryoDev
AuthorDetails.Description: Small open source .NET and JavaScript packages.

Screenshots.Caption: Install adoption in the Settings section: installed devices, install rate, 30-day active, and a device table.
